title: Care Management
description: Care Management documentation for System Caregiver.
overview: This guide covers care management workflows for System Caregiver.

subtasks.title: Follow Up Query
subtasks.purpose: Identify patients due for follow-up across assigned practices using program, provider, caregiver, status and vitals filters.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Care Mgmt → Follow Up Query — the filter form loads with Last / First Name, Provider, Caregiver, Status, Vitals, and Serial #.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Set the filters and click Query — the grid renders #, Status, Vitals, Name, Systolic, Diastolic, Pulse, Glucose, Weight, Last Upload, # Readings, and Time.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Open any row (breadcrumb “System Caregiver Dashboard → Follow Up Query”) to review vitals context and complete or reschedule the follow-up.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Click Reset to clear filters. The empty state “Select filters and click Query to load patients” confirms no query has been run yet.
